value.load_axis: z opening; x shear; moment about y
value.thread_model: smooth solid bolt, NO thread strength claim

inputs.basis: ASSUMPTION original internal 3D eccentric bracket geometry; not an industry dimension
inputs.readiness_test: mesh hash, 3D solids, hole/head contact, normals, bolt cut surfaces, lever-arm resultant
inputs.customer_replaces: owned CAD, tolerances, permitted actions, thread/fastener convention

inputs.basis: NIST table 5.7-1 printed p54 generic carbon/stainless steel; NOT bolt-grade calibration
inputs.readiness_test: units and elastic domain; missing strength/plasticity blocks stress safety
inputs.customer_replaces: same-grade/process material curves, certified allowables, state/temperature domain

value.preload_rule: action is F_Mmax; low clamp is F_Mmax/alpha_A; nominal is endpoint midpoint

inputs.basis: Bossard Jan2025 pp58–59, VDI2230(2015)-derived: experimentally calibrated torque 1.4–1.6, estimated-friction class B 1.6–2.0; scenarios are not probabilities
inputs.readiness_test: force-preload calibration, tightening order, lock displacement and history
inputs.customer_replaces: measured force preload/scatter/correlations and assembly sequence; tightening friction separate

inputs.basis: Bossard p58 general dry steel–steel static faying values; real lower tail may be lower, must measure
inputs.readiness_test: surface/finish/pressure/temperature applicability and uncertainty, not torque friction
inputs.customer_replaces: measured matched faying law and tolerance correlations

inputs.basis: ASSUMPTION representative load exercises; NASA RP1228 establishes the eccentric bolt-group design workflow, NOT these loads/limits
inputs.readiness_test: complete assembly/lock/service sequence, reference frames and explicit measurement/limit authority
inputs.customer_replaces: actual load histories and every acceptance criterion/objective

value.baseline: VDI-style bolt/member compliance plus eccentric group; strongest incumbent also contact-aware cached FE

inputs.basis: CCX2.23 manual contact and pre-tension sections; original hand formulas, not full licensed VDI compliance
inputs.readiness_test: code verification, balance, contact/mesh/history sensitivity and independent buyer-tool witnesses
inputs.customer_replaces: actual solver settings, calibrated stiffness sheet, matched reference/cheap-FE data and costs

commercial_inputs: I01/I13-I17 still require actual buyer identity/use, rights, hardware, cadence, delivery and acceptance/grants; none inferred from rehearsal
